name: Mu3e
notes: No physics results exist yet; the detector is still being assembled (most recent dated evidence: third pixel layer installed 2026-09-16). Stated explicitly rather than left to silence.

physics_goals.quote: We plan an eXperiment to search for the lepton flavour violating decay of the muon to three electrons with a branching ratio sensitivity of 10^{-16}
physics_goals.value: Search for the lepton-flavor-violating decay of a positive muon into two positrons and one electron (mu+ -> e+e+e-) with a branching-ratio sensitivity of 10^-16

summary.plain: An experiment being built at the Paul Scherrer Institute in Switzerland to look for a muon splitting into three lighter particles (two positrons and an electron), which the Standard Model says essentially never happens. It is still under construction.
summary.technical: Mu3e (PSI, on the HiMB/piE5 beamline fed by accelerator:psi-hipa, referenced but owned by the 'facilities' workstream): searches for mu+ -> e+e+e- using an ultra-thin HV-MAPS silicon pixel tracker plus scintillating fibre and tile timing detectors, targeting a branching-ratio sensitivity of 10^-16. As of the most recently fetched official update (2026-09-16), the pixel tracker's third layer had just been installed; the detector remains under construction and no physics result has been produced yet.

unique_capabilities.quote: To this aim, we use innovative high-voltage monolithic active pixel sensors (HV-MAPS)
unique_capabilities.value: Uses innovative high-voltage monolithic active pixel sensors (HV-MAPS) for an ultra-thin, high-rate silicon pixel tracker combined with scintillating-fibre and -tile timing detectors
